gloss: free diving; skin diving; diving without equipment

definitions.gloss: free diving; skin diving; diving without breathing apparatus
definitions.explanation: The practice of diving underwater without scuba gear or other breathing equipment, relying only on holding one's breath.

examples.japanese: {素潜|すもぐ}りで{貝|かい}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To collect shellfish by free diving.

examples.japanese: {素潜|すもぐ}りで{海底|かいてい}まで{潜|もぐ}った。
examples.english: I dove to the ocean floor by free diving.

examples.japanese: {海女|あま}さんたちは{素潜|すもぐ}りで{海|うみ}に{潜|もぐ}り、{鮑|あわび}やサザエを{採|と}ってきた。
examples.english: The ama divers went into the sea by free diving and harvested abalone and turban shells.

notes:
Composed of {素|す} (plain, bare, without accessories) + {潜|もぐ}り (diving). The {素|す} prefix indicates doing something in its simplest, unequipped form — here, diving without any breathing apparatus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素潜|すもぐ}りで{潜|もぐ}る: to dive by free diving
- {素潜|すもぐ}りで{魚|さかな}を{捕|つか}まえる: to catch fish by free diving
- {素潜|すもぐ}りの{漁|りょう}: fishing by free diving
- {素潜|すもぐ}りをする: to do free diving

CULTURAL NOTE:
Free diving has a long tradition in Japan, particularly through the {海女|あま} (female pearl divers and shellfish gatherers) of regions like Mie Prefecture and Shima Peninsula. These divers have practiced {素潜|すもぐ}り for over 2,000 years.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スキューバダイビング: scuba diving — uses breathing equipment; the opposite approach to {素潜|すもぐ}り
- シュノーケリング: snorkeling — uses a snorkel at the surface; {素潜|すもぐ}り involves going fully underwater
- {潜水|せんすい}: diving — a general term for going underwater
